items.title: Clarion Partners’ loan on Netflix-occupied Hollywood campus hits market
items.summary: Clarion’s David Gilbert and 817-827 Vine Street in Hollywood (Clarion, Google Maps)Clarion Partners’ lender is shopping the note on a Netflix-occupied creative office campus in Tinseltown, The Real Deal has learned. Cushman & Wakefield marketing materials viewed by TRD note the loan is on the campus at 817-827 Vine Street in Hollywood, which is completely leased to Netflix until 2031. items.title: Netflix trades at under 18x earnings after a steep valuation reset
items.summary: Investing.com -- Netflix Inc (NFLX) closed at $63.26 on Nov 10, 2026 (3:59 PM EST), with pre-market near $62.91. The market cap is about $259.77B. The stock is down 44.33% over one year and 32.80% year to date. Its 52-week range is $61.39 to $116.73, so it trades near the bottom.
